answer: The raven of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tide of a task receipt, and the cedar is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
